items.Sentence: The treatment system consists of an influent diversion box, three equalization tanks, an automatic bar screen, an oxidation ditch, and a secondary clarifier.
From the equalization basins, raw water passes through the influent junction box, a flow meter and automatic sampler, and then through an automatic bar screen.
The wastewater undergoes biological treatment in the oxidation ditch, followed by solids separation in the secondary clarifier.

Effluent is chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite solution and dechlorinated using a sodium bisulfite prior to discharge.

The Facility also maintains a 4-million-gallon overflow storage pond with a synthetic liner, which can divert flow from the equalization tanks.
